config.title: Heftmap
config.publicDir: Folder against which absolute paths (/models/x.glb) are resolved. The nearest one is searched upwards from each file.
config.git.since: Limit the git history in large repositories, e.g. «1.year». Empty = all of it.
config.usage.ignore: Files (relative paths) that never count as orphans.
config.usage.entryPoints: Extra entry points besides the ones detected automatically.
config.language.auto: The editor's display language (English if it is not Spanish or Basque)
config.language: Language of the Heftmap panel and side view. Command and setting names follow the editor's display language.
capabilities.untrusted: In Restricted Mode Heftmap does not run git: it shows sizes and usage, without history or uncommitted changes. Workspace settings for Heftmap are ignored.
config.refreshDelay: Milliseconds to wait after a change (on disk, in git or in the settings) before analyzing again. Between 250 and 60000.
config.autoRefresh: Analyze again automatically when files or git change. When off, only the Refresh button (or a settings change) analyzes again.
config.maxTextFileSize: Text files larger than this (in MB) are not read: they keep their size, but get no line count and no usage analysis. Between 1 and 50.
config.usage.weakSources: Tooling folders (relative paths). What files inside them name counts as a mention, not as use: a generator names what it writes.
config.exclude: Files and folders Heftmap leaves out completely (not listed, not read, their references do not count), as in .gitignore: «*.snap» or «fixtures» match in any folder; «docs/images» or «src/**/*.gen.ts» are relative to the root; a folder takes everything inside it.
config.hotspots.exclude: Code that does not count in the hotspots (vendored, generated by hand…), with the same patterns as heftmap.exclude. It is still analyzed and shown in the table.
config.panel.defaultArea: Treemap area the panel opens with (Bytes, Balanced or Lines). Only used when the panel has no saved state: what you choose in the panel wins.
config.panel.defaultColor: Colour the panel opens with (Extension, Usage, Age, Recent commits or Changes). Only used when the panel has no saved state: what you choose in the panel wins.
